l4_steps.name: Load ACARS datalink frequencies for planned route
l4_steps.input: Filed flight plan with route and frequency plan
l4_steps.output: ACARS datalink profile loaded for flight
l4_steps.kpi: Datalink configuration complete ≥15 min before departure
l4_steps.pain_point: ACARS frequency gaps over oceanic or remote continental segments require fallback to HF voice, increasing dispatcher workload by 40%

l4_steps.name: Assign and verify SELCAL code for aircraft
l4_steps.input: Aircraft tail number, route segment with HF requirement
l4_steps.output: Confirmed SELCAL code entered in flight plan and crew briefing
l4_steps.kpi: SELCAL assignment accuracy 100%; no duplicate codes per sector
l4_steps.pain_point: SELCAL code conflicts across shared fleet pools cause missed ATC calls; manual cross-check process has no automated deconfliction in legacy ACARS ground system

l4_steps.name: Test ACARS uplink connectivity with Operations Control
l4_steps.input: Aircraft powered-on ACARS avionics, OCC datalink server status
l4_steps.output: Two-way ACARS test message acknowledged; link quality confirmed
l4_steps.kpi: Uplink test round-trip <90 seconds; link quality ≥95% message delivery
l4_steps.pain_point: Gate-to-aircraft ACARS connectivity failures affect ~3% of departures; ground crew must physically confirm avionics status with no automated alert to dispatch

l4_steps.name: Activate voice backup if ACARS uplink fails
l4_steps.input: Failed ACARS uplink test result
l4_steps.output: VHF Company frequency and phone patch number issued to crew; failure logged
l4_steps.kpi: Voice backup activation within 5 min of confirmed datalink failure
l4_steps.pain_point: Voice backup coordination relies on manual frequency lookups; no integrated fallback workflow in dispatch system creates inconsistent crew briefing quality

l4_steps.name: Transmit OUT and OFF OOOI messages via ACARS
l4_steps.input: Aircraft door close and wheels-off events from FMS
l4_steps.output: OUT/OFF timestamps transmitted to OCC and airline operations system
l4_steps.kpi: OOOI transmission latency <30 seconds of triggering event; 99.5% capture rate
l4_steps.pain_point: Automatic OOOI triggering depends on door-closure sensor accuracy; carrier-specific wiring faults on ageing narrowbodies cause delayed or missed OUT messages, distorting OTP metrics

l4_steps.name: Send initial position report and fuel state to dispatch
l4_steps.input: Departure fuel uplift, FMS waypoint sequence, ATC initial clearance
l4_steps.output: Position report with fuel on board (FOB) and cleared altitude uplinked to OCC
l4_steps.kpi: Initial report transmitted within 10 min of wheels-off
l4_steps.pain_point: Manual crew entry of FOB in FliteDeck creates transcription errors; no automated FMS-to-ACARS fuel bridge in older EFB configurations

l4_steps.name: Evaluate departure delay or route amendment requirement
l4_steps.input: ATC slot allocation, departure ATIS, updated SIGMET/AIRMET data
l4_steps.output: Decision: standard departure confirmed or amended clearance required
l4_steps.kpi: Route amendment decision issued ≥5 min before off-block when ATC delay >15 min
l4_steps.pain_point: ATC ground delay programmes (GDPs) issued with <10 min notice require simultaneous reroute and crew notification; NAVBLUE slot management tool lacks real-time GDP ingestion from FAA TFMS

l4_steps.name: Uplink revised route clearance or holding instructions
l4_steps.input: ATC revised clearance or GDP holding instruction
l4_steps.output: Amended route or holding fix uplinked and crew-acknowledged via ACARS CPDLC
l4_steps.kpi: Crew acknowledgement received within 3 min of uplink; amendment compliance 100%
l4_steps.pain_point: CPDLC message formatting errors between airline system and FAA FANS-1/A avionics create rejected uplinks requiring voice re-confirmation, adding 4–8 min average delay

l4_steps.name: Monitor automated ACARS position reports en-route
l4_steps.input: FMS periodic position reports (10–30 min intervals per route type)
l4_steps.output: Real-time flight track displayed in OCC; anomalies flagged for dispatcher review
l4_steps.kpi: Position report receipt interval ≤30 min; missed report alert within 5 min of overdue
l4_steps.pain_point: ACARS position reporting gaps over North Atlantic and Pacific oceanic tracks require manual ADS-C polling; latency up to 15 min leaves dispatch with stale situational awareness

l4_steps.name: Process and acknowledge dispatch uplink messages
l4_steps.input: Weather updates, NOTAM amendments, fuel revised calculations from dispatch
l4_steps.output: Crew acknowledgement sent; updated parameters loaded in FMS as required
l4_steps.kpi: Uplink acknowledgement within 5 min for operational messages; 100% receipt confirmation
l4_steps.pain_point: High-volume uplink queues during irregular operations (IRROPs) overload crew attention; no message priority ranking in FliteDeck causes safety-critical messages to queue behind routine updates

l4_steps.name: Execute HF radio handoff for oceanic or remote operations
l4_steps.input: Oceanic entry waypoint, assigned HF frequencies from route briefing
l4_steps.output: HF contact established with Oceanic ATC or ARINC/SITA HF network
l4_steps.kpi: HF contact established within 10 min of oceanic FIR entry; first-call success rate ≥90%
l4_steps.pain_point: HF propagation variability in high-latitude routes (NAT track system) causes failed initial contacts; airlines without SATCOM-equipped fleets have no reliable backup, risking SLOP deviation reporting failures

l4_steps.name: Assess weather deviation or emergency communication need
l4_steps.input: PIREPs, SIGMET updates, crew request for deviation or emergency declaration
l4_steps.output: Decision: routine ops continue OR deviation/emergency coordination initiated
l4_steps.kpi: Dispatcher response to crew deviation request <2 min; emergency acknowledgement <1 min
l4_steps.pain_point: Weather deviation requests during oceanic segments require simultaneous ATC and OCC coordination over SATCOM and ACARS; latency in SATCOM voice degrades timely clearance issuance

l4_steps.name: Coordinate weather deviation or emergency with ATC and OCC
l4_steps.input: Crew deviation request, SIGMET polygon, alternate routing from NAVBLUE
l4_steps.output: ATC deviation clearance relayed to crew; OCC fuel and alternate analysis completed
l4_steps.kpi: Deviation clearance loop closed (crew request → ATC clearance → crew confirmation) <15 min
l4_steps.pain_point: Multi-party coordination chain (crew → dispatch → ATC → dispatch → crew) has no single-system view; handoffs via separate ACARS and voice systems create documentation gaps for post-event safety review

l4_steps.name: Receive and acknowledge D-ATIS update via datalink
l4_steps.input: Destination airport D-ATIS broadcast (IATA code, ATIS identifier letter)
l4_steps.output: Current ATIS letter confirmed in crew acknowledgement; approach brief updated
l4_steps.kpi: D-ATIS received ≥30 min before destination ETA; ATIS currency check at top of descent
l4_steps.pain_point: Airports without D-ATIS capability require VHF voice ATIS, adding crew workload; ATIS letter change between receipt and landing causes approach briefing invalidation with no automated crew alert

l4_steps.name: Transmit final ETA and fuel state to dispatch and OCC
l4_steps.input: FMS top-of-descent calculations, current FOB, ATC ETA slot
l4_steps.output: ETA and FOB report uplinked; OCC arrival planning triggered
l4_steps.kpi: ETA accuracy ±3 min versus actual on-blocks; fuel state report within 1 min of TOD
l4_steps.pain_point: FMS ETA drift in RVSM/RNP environments caused by ATC tactical vectoring is not automatically pushed to ACARS; dispatcher uses stale ETA for gate planning, causing downstream turnaround delays

l4_steps.name: Confirm destination availability with dispatch
l4_steps.input: Destination NOTAMs, RVR, field condition report, ATC ATIS status
l4_steps.output: Decision: destination available for landing OR diversion to alternate required
l4_steps.kpi: Go/no-go decision for destination communicated to crew ≥20 min before ETA
l4_steps.pain_point: NAVBLUE NOTAM integration does not ingest real-time runway contamination SNOWTAM data; dispatchers must manually cross-check ATIS and ATC PIREPs, creating decision latency in winter operations

l4_steps.name: Coordinate diversion to alternate airport if required
l4_steps.input: Diversion trigger (weather, NOTAM, fuel state), alternate airport list from flight plan
l4_steps.output: Alternate airport confirmed; revised routing, fuel check, and crew notification completed
l4_steps.kpi: Alternate airport decision and crew uplink <5 min of diversion trigger; fuel sufficient for alternate + 30 min holding confirmed
l4_steps.pain_point: Alternate airport ATIS and gate availability data not integrated in NAVBLUE; dispatcher must manually contact destination OCC and alternate airport ops, adding 8–12 min to diversion coordination loop

l4_steps.name: Download and archive ACARS message logs post-flight
l4_steps.input: Full ACARS message thread for completed flight (uplinks and downlinks)
l4_steps.output: Archived communications log stored in data lake; indexed by flight ID and date
l4_steps.kpi: 100% of ACARS logs archived within 2 hours of on-blocks; retention period ≥24 months per ICAO Annex 6
l4_steps.pain_point: SITA ACARS ground system purges raw message buffers after 72 hours; airlines without automated archive pipelines lose communications audit trails required for accident investigation and FAA inspection

l4_steps.name: Review post-flight communications for anomalies or gaps
l4_steps.input: Archived ACARS log, OOOI timestamps, dispatcher notes from flight
l4_steps.output: Anomaly report or clean-flight confirmation; flagged items routed for investigation
l4_steps.kpi: Post-flight communications review completed within 24 hours of arrival; anomaly detection rate ≥95% vs manual audit
l4_steps.pain_point: No automated anomaly detection across ACARS and voice logs; analysts manually cross-reference two separate systems, limiting review throughput to ~30 flights/analyst/day

l4_steps.name: File ATC communications deviation or irregularity report
l4_steps.input: Anomaly flag from post-flight review, dispatcher event notes
l4_steps.output: Mandatory irregularity report filed; safety management system (SMS) notification sent
l4_steps.kpi: Deviation report filed within 48 hours of event per FAR Part 121.711; 100% compliance with ASAP/ASRS voluntary reporting where applicable
l4_steps.pain_point: Dispatcher irregularity reporting workflow is disconnected from ACARS archive system; manual re-entry of message evidence into SMS creates transcription errors and delays in safety trend analysis
